title: Chapter 16: Black Water Skill
paragraphs: Human hearts are truly treacherous,Chen Mobai sighed inwardly as he left Wu Ji Gold Store.
No wonder so many cultivators preferred to pay a premium at reputable brand-name shops—at least those establishments wouldn't try to lure every customer into illegal schemes.

While fabricating transactions to earn Points was common practice within the Immortal Sect, such deals were typically reserved for trusted acquaintances, where both parties held leverage over each other. Chen Mobai and Wu Wan had only done business once and shared no mutual trust whatsoever.

Chen Mobai was still young. Given his current cultivation progress, coupled with the Second-Tier Spiritual Land at the Water Abode, he was certain to reach Qi Refinement Completion and attempt Foundation Establishment. There was simply no need for such reckless ventures yet.
After this unsettling transaction, Chen Mobai's initial plans to continue browsing the shops were completely soured.
Taking public transport home, he decided to treat himself, flush with his newfound wealth. He skipped trimming Talisman Paper, didn't bother cooking, and ordered a spicy mala hotpot instead.

While waiting for his takeout, Chen Mobai scanned the entireDetailed Explanation of the Azure Water Formationinto a document and sent it to Teacher Chan. Then, he pulled out theBlackwater Artand began to read.

This was a typical Water Attribute Qi Refinement Technique, comprising nine layers of cultivation that could lead one all the way to Qi Refinement Completion. It also included three accompanying spells:
1. Water Control Spell 2. Water Essence Shield 3. Ice Cold Spell
The three spells progressed sequentially. TheWater Control Spellwas the simplest, but mastering it required considerable time.

Once proficient in Water Control, one could manipulate refined spiritual water to form theWater Essence Shield, a defensive technique that served as an alternative to defensive Magic Tools and was popular among low-level cultivators.
The final spell, theIce Cold Spell, was the most challenging.

According to theBlackwater Art, practitioners first needed to condense their spiritual power into a frigid breath of ice. Then, by combining this with theWater Control Spell, they could freeze refined spiritual water into any desired shape, for either offensive or defensive purposes.
Although the technique itself was straightforward, it formed a complete system. Moreover, practicing the three spells could, in turn, accelerate one's progress in the Qi Refinement stage.
"Not bad, not bad. If my Water Spiritual Root Attribute weren't only 23, I'd switch to cultivating this immediately."

The Immortal Sect's major hospitals had conducted experiments showing that if a Spiritual Root Attribute exceeded 33 points, cultivating the Five Elements Art became less efficient than practicing a single-attribute Qi Refinement Technique.

For someone like Chen Mobai, whose talent bordered on Pseudo Spiritual Root status, the Five Elements Art remained the most suitable path for both cultivation progress and Spiritual Energy refinement efficiency.
Apart from its reference value, the greatest benefit of the Blackwater Art for Chen Mobai lay in the three Spells it contained.

While knowledge within the Immortal Sect was generally shared, it still required Points for exchange. Moreover, before acquiring a Spell from the sect, one had to swear an oath to cultivate it solely for personal use and never teach it to others.
The only legitimate means of teaching Spells publicly was through schools.

Chen Mobai's Lightness Technique, Cleansing Spell, Qi Nourishment Technique, and similar skills had all been taught at school. However, most students, having been indoctrinated with the ideology of cultivation supremacy from a young age, only pursued Spells useful for daily convenience.
After all, Diyuan Star was exceedingly peaceful. Petty theft and tax evasion were common, but major crimes like murder had been unheard of for a very long time.
Only when the Great War of Conquest drew near would cultivators begin practicing combat-oriented spells.

In peacetime, students at the academy focused entirely on Qi Refinement, striving to advance their cultivation stage. Their goal was to reach Qi Refinement Completion as quickly as possible and then attempt to break through to Foundation Establishment.
Just as Chen Mobai was comparing his Water Essence Shield with the Flowing Water Shield Old Man Ding had given him, the doorbell rang.
His takeout order had arrived.
Chen Mobai went into the kitchen, poured the Mala Tang into a bowl, and was about to scoop some Spiritual Rice to eat when he noticed a fish in the sink—gutted but still vaguely familiar.
Huh, isn't that the fish I brought back from the Water Abode?He'd been in such a hurry that morning, he'd cleaned the spoils and casually tossed it into the sink.
He'd planned to make boiled fish that evening to avoid wasting it, but after making a fortune selling gold, he'd completely forgotten about it.
Mom must have cleaned it when she left.

Thinking this, Chen Mobai glanced at the translucent, faintly pinkish-white fish flesh. With a swift stroke of his knife, he sliced the fish into bite-sized pieces. He then lit the stove, poured his spicy hotpot broth into the pot as the base, and carefully added the fish slices one by one.
After all his effort, the moment the tender, spicy fish melted in his mouth, Chen Mobai closed his eyes in satisfaction.
Once he had eaten his fill, he wasted no time teleporting to the Water Abode.
The next day, during class, Chen Mobai stared at his phone screen with a peculiar expression.

He had a habit of recording his cultivation sessions with his phone, then importing the footage into a software called "Cultivation Assistant." By comparing the latest recording with previous ones, he could identify discrepancies, correct errors, and retain successful techniques.
The "Cultivation Assistant" software hadn't displayed a pop-up notification for half a year, indicating that both his cultivation duration and posture were optimal, leaving no room for improvement.
But this morning, a pop-up suddenly appeared:
Detected: The Spiritual Power cultivated by the user last night contains 2 points more Water Attribute than usual. Please investigate the cause.
The Cultivation Assistant identified the discrepancy but didn't analyze the underlying reasons. Users had to investigate themselves and provide feedback.
Chen Mobai reviewed his cultivation session from the previous day. It was identical to his previous sessions in the Water Abode, down to his position on the Meditation Cushion.
Puzzled, he resolved to conduct further experiments.
That night, Chen Mobai activated his recording and cultivated in the Water Abode. His Five Elements Art showed further progress.
Another pop-up appeared:
Detected: The Spiritual Power cultivated by the user last night contains 2 points less Water Attribute than yesterday. Please investigate the cause.

Chen Mobai confirmed that something must have been different about him the day before yesterday. The "Cultivation Assistant" software, developed by the Heaven Mending Dao Academy—one of the Four Great Dao Academies—had been refined over centuries and was now remarkably precise.
If the software wasn't malfunctioning, what exactly had gone wrong with him?
Chen Mobai sank into deep thought, retracing his every step from the day before yesterday.
Class, consulting Teacher Chan, reading and experimenting with the Needle Case in the Cultivation Chamber, selling gold...
When he recalled Wu Ji Gold Store, Chen Mobai frowned slightly. He was certain he hadn't made any physical contact with Wu Wan; they had merely talked and completed a transaction.
His memory continued to rewind: ordering takeout, slicing fish, eating, returning to the Water Abode for cultivation, then back to class!

A complete circle of events crystallized in Chen Mobai's mind. He considered what had been different that day compared to his usual routine—something significant enough to influence the adaptive Spiritual Power cultivated through the Five Elements Art. The most likely explanation was a change in his Spiritual Root Attribute Points.
The takeout?!

Chen Mobai recalled the food he had consumed. Could it have influenced his Spiritual Root? But that shouldn't be possible. He had secretly ordered takeout several times before without triggering the Cultivation Assistant's alert window.
Could it be... there was something wrong with that fish?
